extracted.stage: Children and finance matter with hearing listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether a £2,000 loan to cover a single counsel's fee for a 2 October hearing at Bristol Family Court, in a matter with around £169,500 of assets in dispute, meets the minimum loan size.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To review it properly we would need the client's full name and contact details, confirmation of the nature and current stage of the financial remedy proceedings, and details of the assets in dispute including any existing charges or competing claims. It would also help to have a breakdown of the costs to be funded and confirmation of whether any further fees are anticipated beyond the counsel's fee mentioned. A member of the team will be in touch once we have had the chance to consider the information provided. Please note that nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding or an indication of terms.
